title: Lunenburg Heritage Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: **Discover the charm of Lunenburg, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of Nova Scotia's most picturesque towns.** Stroll through colorful historic streets, admire the vibrant waterfront, and immerse yourself in the town's rich maritime heritage. Enjoy free time to explore local cafés, restaurants, bakeries, and unique boutiques, where you can sample fresh seafood, homemade treats, or a great cup of coffee. With breathtaking coastal scenery, fascinating history, and plenty of photo opportunities, this tour offers the perfect blend of culture, relaxation, and authentic Nova Scotia flavors.
